title: Pros and cons
focus: 优点 · 缺点 · 条件 · 标准 · 方面 · 意义 · 作用 · 至于
body:
# Pros and cons

The vocabulary for weighing things up: strengths and weaknesses, conditions and standards, and whether something has any point. Useful for job offers, flats and arguments with parents.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 优点 | yōudiǎn | good quality / strong point (of a person or thing) | excellent point → strength |
| 缺点 | quēdiǎn | shortcoming / weakness (of a person or thing) | lacking point → weakness |
| 条件 | tiáojiàn | conditions / requirements (e.g. meet the ___; also material circumstances) | itemized terms → conditions |
| 标准 | biāozhǔn | standard / criterion | mark of accuracy → benchmark |
| 方面 | fāngmiàn | aspect / respect (in terms of ...) | side something faces → aspect |
| 意义 | yìyì | meaning / significance (the point of something) | meaning behind it → significance |
| 作用 | zuòyòng | role / function (what something does or is for) | the work it does → function |
| 至于 | zhìyú | as for / as to (moving to another point) | reaching the next point → as for |

## Which word?

**意义 vs 意思**: 意思 is what words mean (or 'interesting'); 意义 is significance or purpose (有什么意义？ = what's the point?).

**作用 vs 影响 (L2)**: 作用 is the job something does, usually good (起作用 = it works); 影响 is any effect, often bad.

## Sentences

- 这份工作收入高，就是没什么意义。 zhè fèn gōngzuò shōurù gāo, jiù shì méi shénme yìyì: This job pays well. It just doesn't mean much.
- 相处久了，优点缺点都看得清清楚楚。 xiāngchǔ jiǔ le, yōudiǎn quēdiǎn dōu kàn de qīngqīngchǔchǔ: Spend enough time with someone and you see all their good and bad points.
- 这套房子条件不错，最大的优点是划算。 zhè tào fángzi tiáojiàn búcuò, zuì dà de yōudiǎn shì huásuàn: This flat is in good shape, and the best thing about it is the price.
- 按公司的标准，这方面还得调整。 àn gōngsī de biāozhǔn, zhè fāngmiàn hái děi tiáozhěng: By the company's standards, this aspect still needs adjusting.
- 经验方面，他确实比我强。 jīngyàn fāngmiàn, tā quèshí bǐ wǒ qiáng: When it comes to experience, he really is better than me.
- 拖延了这么久，现在做还有什么意义？ tuōyán le zhème jiǔ, xiànzài zuò hái yǒu shénme yìyì: After putting it off this long, what's the point of doing it now?
- 你的建议起了很大作用。 nǐ de jiànyì qǐ le hěn dà zuòyòng: Your suggestion made a big difference. (had a big effect)
- 先把计划定下来，至于细节，下周再讨论。 xiān bǎ jìhuà dìng xiàlai, zhìyú xìjié, xià zhōu zài tǎolùn: Let's fix the plan first. As for the details, we'll discuss them next week.

cards.English: good quality / strong point (of a person or thing)
cards.Example: 他最大的优点是有耐心。 tā zuì dà de yōudiǎn shì yǒu nàixīn: His best quality is that he's patient
cards.Notes: 优 yōu excellent (优秀) + 点 diǎn point (重点) = an excellent point. Mirror: 缺点 shortcoming. vs 优势 = an edge over others; 优点 = a good quality you have.

cards.English: shortcoming / weakness (of a person or thing)
cards.Example: 这个方案的缺点是太贵。 zhège fāng'àn de quēdiǎn shì tài guì: The downside of this plan is that it's too expensive
cards.Notes: 缺 quē lack (缺少, 缺钱) + 点 diǎn point (重点, 一点) = a point where something is lacking. Mirror: 优点. Colloquial: 毛病.

cards.English: conditions / requirements (e.g. meet the ___; also material circumstances)
cards.Example: 他们家条件不错。 tāmen jiā tiáojiàn búcuò: Their family is pretty well off
cards.Notes: 条 tiáo item, clause (一条, 条约) + 件 jiàn item (文件, 一件事) = the itemized terms. A family's 条件 = its circumstances (他们家条件不错 = well off). Also deal terms: 你有什么条件？ 前提 is the one prerequisite everything depends on.

cards.Example: 每个人的标准不一样。 měi gè rén de biāozhǔn bù yíyàng: Everyone has different standards
cards.Notes: 标 biāo mark, sign (标志, 目标) + 准 zhǔn accurate (准确, 准时) = the mark of accuracy, a benchmark. Also an adjective: 他普通话很标准. Shares 标 with 目标.

cards.Example: 在工作方面，他很认真。 zài gōngzuò fāngmiàn, tā hěn rènzhēn: When it comes to work, he's very conscientious
cards.Notes: 方 fāng direction, side (方向, 地方) + 面 miàn face, side (面前, 外面) = a side something faces: an aspect. 一方面……另一方面…… = on the one hand ... on the other. Family: 全面 all sides / 片面 one-sided.

cards.Example: 这样做有什么意义？ zhèyàng zuò yǒu shénme yìyì: What's the point of doing it this way?
cards.Notes: 意 yì meaning, intention (意思, 注意) + 义 yì sense, meaning (定义 definition, 字义) = the meaning behind something. 意思 = meaning of words or 'interesting'; 意义 = significance or purpose.

cards.English: role / function (what something does or is for)
cards.Example: 这个药没什么作用。 zhège yào méi shénme zuòyòng: This medicine doesn't really do anything
cards.Notes: 作 zuò do, act (工作, 作业) + 用 yòng use (有用, 用处) = the work something does, its use. 起作用 = to take effect, to work. The positive counterpart to 影响.

cards.English: as for / as to (moving to another point)
cards.Example: 先把工作做完，至于去不去旅游，以后再说。 xiān bǎ gōngzuò zuò wán, zhìyú qù bú qù lǚyóu, yǐhòu zàishuō: Finish the work first; as for the trip, we'll see later
cards.Notes: 至 zhì reach (至少, 甚至) + 于 yú to, at = reaching (the next point): as for. 至于吗？ alone = 'Is that really necessary?' (does it really reach that point; you're overreacting).

cards.English: This job pays well. It just doesn't mean much.
cards.Hanzi: 这份工作收入高，就是没什么意义。
cards.Pinyin: zhè fèn gōngzuò shōurù gāo, jiù shì méi shénme yìyì.
cards.Notes: 意义 (L11) + 收入 (L9). 就是 here = 'it's just that' (the one catch).

cards.English: Spend enough time with someone and you see all their good and bad points.
cards.Hanzi: 相处久了，优点缺点都看得清清楚楚。
cards.Pinyin: xiāngchǔ jiǔ le, yōudiǎn quēdiǎn dōu kàn de qīngqīngchǔchǔ.
cards.Notes: 优点 (L11) + 缺点 (L11) + 相处 (L8). 清清楚楚 = doubled for emphasis: totally clear.

cards.English: This flat is in good shape, and the best thing about it is the price.
cards.Hanzi: 这套房子条件不错，最大的优点是划算。
cards.Pinyin: zhè tào fángzi tiáojiàn búcuò, zuì dà de yōudiǎn shì huásuàn.
cards.Notes: 条件 (L11) + 优点 (L11) + 划算 (L9). 套 is the measure word for a flat.

cards.English: By the company's standards, this aspect still needs adjusting.
cards.Hanzi: 按公司的标准，这方面还得调整。
cards.Pinyin: àn gōngsī de biāozhǔn, zhè fāngmiàn hái děi tiáozhěng.
cards.Notes: 标准 (L11) + 方面 (L11) + 调整 (L10). 按 = according to (same 按 as 按时).

cards.English: When it comes to experience, he really is better than me.
cards.Hanzi: 经验方面，他确实比我强。
cards.Pinyin: jīngyàn fāngmiàn, tā quèshí bǐ wǒ qiáng.
cards.Notes: 方面 (L11) + 经验 (L4) + 确实 (L1). X方面 at the start = 'in terms of X'.

cards.English: After putting it off this long, what's the point of doing it now?
cards.Hanzi: 拖延了这么久，现在做还有什么意义？
cards.Pinyin: tuōyán le zhème jiǔ, xiànzài zuò hái yǒu shénme yìyì?
cards.Notes: 意义 (L11) + 拖延 (L10). 有什么意义？ = what's the point?

cards.English: Your suggestion made a big difference. (had a big effect)
cards.Hanzi: 你的建议起了很大作用。
cards.Pinyin: nǐ de jiànyì qǐ le hěn dà zuòyòng.
cards.Notes: 作用 (L11) + 建议 (L3). 起作用 = take effect, work.

cards.English: Let's fix the plan first. As for the details, we'll discuss them next week.
cards.Hanzi: 先把计划定下来，至于细节，下周再讨论。
cards.Pinyin: xiān bǎ jìhuà dìng xiàlai, zhìyú xìjié, xià zhōu zài tǎolùn.
cards.Notes: 至于 (L11) + 计划 (L10) + 讨论 (L3). 至于吗？ on its own = 'is that really necessary?'
